hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that replaces standard concentrated liquidity with a proprietary bonding curve backed by Euler lending vault reserves. All swap logic executes in beforeSwap: the hook takes input tokens, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and enforces a curve invariant on updated reserves, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta.
